heading.purpose: Technical section and title labels where explicitly used.

shadows.name: control-xs
shadows.purpose: Subtle edge on inputs and compact cards.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact magenta action with tactile press and visible keyboard focus.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary) 80%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: .5; pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Neutral secondary action for utility flows and table controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: all 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--muted); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Compact transparent field with subtle inset depth and a shared focus ring.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; min-width: 0; height: 32px; padding: 4px 10px; color: var(--foreground); background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-input:disabled { opacity: .5; cursor: not-allowed; } .ds-input[aria-invalid=true] { border-color: var(--destructive); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--destructive) 20%, transparent); }

components.name: Active Navigation Item
components.description: Icon-led route item with a distinct active surface and accessible focus.
components.html: Leaderboard
components.css: .ds-nav-active { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 32px; padding: 6px 8px; color: var(--foreground); background: var(--muted); border-radius: var(--radius-md); text-decoration: none; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-active svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; } .ds-nav-active:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 75%, var(--primary) 25%); } .ds-nav-active:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); outline-offset: 1px; }

components.name: Data Card
components.description: Border-defined container for a compact comparison or summary.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; color: var(--card-foreground); background: var(--card); border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: var(--radius-lg); } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 500 14px/1.4 var(--font-heading); } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Table Row
components.description: Compact statistics row with restrained hover and tabular figures.
components.css: .ds-table-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 16px; padding: 8px; color: var(--foreground); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border); font: 400 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); transition: background 150ms ease; } .ds-table-row:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--muted) 50%, transparent); } .ds-table-row .ds-stat { font-family: var(--font-mono); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
SFL Stats is a compact, competitive workbench for reading league performance. Its interface puts dense, demo-derived records and comparisons first: a clear sans-serif carries the working text, monospaced figures support quick scanning, and a vivid magenta accent marks the primary action and selected states. The mood is competitive and energetic, expressed through purposeful color and responsive controls rather than a wholesale esports spectacle.

The visual system balances a bright, white light theme with a mauve-tinted dark theme. Fine borders and muted surfaces organize the work area; selective shadows make controls and overlays tactile. Navigation stays icon-led and task-oriented, while tables remain the central high-density pattern.
keyCharacteristics: Compact, data-dense layouts with tabular and monospaced statistics.
Vivid league magenta against quiet, mauve-tinted neutrals.
Border-defined surfaces, with restrained lift for interactive layers.
Paired light and dark themes; the default follows the system preference.

rules.name: The Accent Signal Rule
rules.body: Use magenta to identify the primary action or an active state, not as a substitute for the neutral structure that makes dense data readable.

rules.name: The Figure-Face Rule
rules.body: Use Geist Mono or tabular numerals for statistics and ranks when alignment improves comparison; do not apply a monospaced face to all prose.

rules.name: The Layer-on-Intent Rule
rules.body: Reserve stronger shadows for content that overlays or temporarily rises above the work surface.

dos: Do preserve both light and dark semantic color assignments; the theme changes the actual values behind shared roles.
Do use the magenta accent for primary actions and active states, retaining neutral surfaces for the bulk of dense data.
Do keep visible keyboard focus rings and the established disabled and invalid treatments.
Do preserve horizontal table overflow when column relationships matter on narrow screens.
Do treat SFL Rating as a provisional custom score, not an official HLTV rating.
donts: Don't present Faceit context as the source of SFL league statistics or SFL Rating.
Don't imply that demo-derived statistics or provisional ratings are official tournament results.
Don't apply strong shadows indiscriminately to data cards and sections.
Don't use decorative magenta where it competes with the meaning of data or status colors.
